reason: I'll make the star pattern first; the punch and card clearly belong together.
expectation: I expect a disc with star-shaped holes, though I don't yet know how its shadows will look.

alternatives.reason: Lining the box also advances construction, but making the stars seems more directly connected to the goal.

effect: The star disc is ready; it can now be attached to the spindle.
reaction: A straightforward preparation, though I’m curious what the shadows will look like.
reason: Attaching the spindle should let the star disc turn.
expectation: I expect a mounted star disc that can rotate, though it may still need fitting into the box.

alternatives.reason: The box needs lining too, but I want to finish the rotating disc first.

effect: The star disc and spindle have become a shadow wheel; the box is the next part to prepare.
reaction: The wheel came together simply, but its shadow effect is still unknown.
reason: Lining the box is the only offered combination and should prepare it for the light.
expectation: I expect the lining to be fitted inside the theatre box, perhaps helping reflect the lamp’s light.

effect: The lining redirects light toward the star disc while staying clear of electrical contacts; the lamp is next.
reaction: The explanation makes the lining’s purpose clear.
reason: The lamp is the only offered combination and supplies the light needed for the shadows.
expectation: I expect the LED module to be fitted inside the box, but it may still need its switched supply.

effect: The lamp is fitted, and the switched supply is the next available part.
reaction: A straightforward installation; I still want to see the shadows.
reason: The switched supply is the only offered combination and should power the lamp.
expectation: I expect the lamp supply to be connected, making the light ready to switch on.

effect: The theatre now has power, so the shadow wheel can be fitted.
reaction: Another straightforward installation; I’m still curious about the projected stars.
reason: The shadow wheel is the only offered combination and should bring the rotating star pattern into the theatre.
expectation: I expect the wheel to be mounted in the powered box, though it may need another step before the shadows are visible.

effect: The wheel is mounted between the lamp and opening; its holes let through patches of light that will move when the disc turns. The chapter goal is complete.
reaction: That explains the mechanism clearly, though I would have liked to see the shadows tested.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the shadow wheel was most worthwhile: it brought the parts together and explained how turning the disc moves the light patches.

leastWorthwhile.text: Installing the lamp and then its supply felt like straightforward consecutive preparations, with little to decide between them.

surprise.text: The reflective lining sends otherwise lost light back toward the disc; I had only tentatively expected it to help reflect light.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, although several installations were simply the only offered action.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see what the star shadows actually look like; the mechanism is clear, but the visual result remains untested here.
